name: Production Parking Orchestrator
tagline: Operate an enterprise parking platform through continuous incidents and traffic surges.
brief: Coordinate mixed parking traffic, incident recoveries, and gate turnover across multi-zone facilities.
context: The facility chooses an exact bay inside your selected category; your control system manages service order, category, waiting, and exits.
narrative:
You are Principal Infrastructure Architect for ParkFlow!

Your system controls an enterprise multi-zone airport parking platform. Arrivals, departures, charging outages, lane congestion, gate failures, and reservation cancellations occur simultaneously across multiple zones.

Design a durable real-time orchestrator: enforce safety invariants, protect driver patience, manage back-pressure, and pass 10 adversarial test scenarios!
objective: Maximise safe completed departures while minimising abandonment, preference loss, queue growth, rerouting, congestion, and operating penalty.
learningObjective: Engineer an enterprise facility orchestrator with back-pressure handling, fairness, and incident recovery.
intelligenceExplanation:
Structure your rules in distinct layers:
1. Hard Safety: Check category availability (`reservedAvailable`, `accessibleAvailable`, `largeAvailable`, `standardAvailable`) before allocating.
2. Service & Fairness: Authorize exit releases to recover capacity and prevent arrival queue abandonment.
3. Rerouting & Optimization: Fall back to safe alternatives when primary bays close.
hint: Build in layers: safety constraints first, exit recovery and patience second, and optimization preferences third.
hints: Prioritize exit releases when capacity is constrained.
Submit evaluates your system across 10 hidden multi-zone scenarios.
